Ele acrescentou que esperava que a tecnologia melhorasse e começasse a mostrar mais benefícios nos próximos três a seis meses. À medida que Zuckerberg tem atenuado os aspectos mais disruptivos da transformação interna em IA, ele também lançou uma campanha intensiva de relações públicas posicionando a Meta como uma empresa centrada nas pessoas. A iniciativa incluiu um anúncio em vídeo proclamando que a empresa está “apostando nas pessoas”. Na campanha, que também incluiu um ensaio recente de 6.500 palavras delineando sua visão para o futuro da IA, o presidente-executivo destacou os planos da Meta de tornar a criação de agentes de IA mais fácil para o usuário, ao mesmo tempo em que retratou concorrentes não identificados como os verdadeiros destruidores de empregos. Em uma publicação interna em junho, ele disse aos funcionários: “Somos a única grande empresa focada em empoderar as pessoas e colocar o poder dessa nova tecnologia nas mãos de bilhões de pessoas em todos os nossos produtos -- em vez de nos concentrarmos principalmente na automação do trabalho.” Ainda assim, Zuckerberg tem se mantido fiel às expressões “em toda a empresa” e “este ano” ao discutir demissões em massa com os funcionários, de acordo com suas comunicações internas. Isso levou alguns funcionários a especular que ele continuará reduzindo o quadro de pessoal por meio de cortes específicos por equipe ou demissões em massa baseadas no desempenho -- ou adiará as reduções de pessoal em toda a empresa até o próximo ano. A empresa enfrenta um aperto de caixa e o escrutínio dos investidores devido aos seus gastos vertiginosos com IA, o que aumenta a pressão para encontrar formas de economizar. A Meta planeja investir pelo menos US$130 bilhões em chips de IA e outra infraestrutura este ano, o que, segundo estimativas da LSEG, deve esgotar seu caixa operacional em 2026, na avaliação de analistas. Em seu ensaio sobre o futuro da IA, intitulado “O Futuro é para Todos”, Zuckerberg prevê que poderá haver “uma abundância de empregos no futuro”. Mas algumas empresas podem acabar com menos funcionários. “O tamanho das empresas pode diminuir -- assim como aconteceu na transição das gigantes industriais para as empresas de tecnologia”, escreve ele. “Mas isso não significa menos empregos no geral. Implica em um número maior de empresas com menos pessoas em cada uma delas.”

item.title: Moonshot negocia divisão de receitas de IA com Microsoft, Amazon e Google, dizem fontes
item.description: A Moonshot AI está negociando acordos de repartição de receitas com Microsoft , Amazon e Google , que permitiriam que as gigantes norte-americanas de computação em nuvem hospedem o modelo de inteligência artificial Kimi K3 da companhia chinesa, segundo três fontes a par das negociações.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Moonshot AI está negociando acordos de repartição de receitas com Microsoft (MSFT.O) , Amazon (AMZN.O) e Google (GOOGL.O) , que permitiriam que as gigantes norte-americanas de computação em nuvem hospedem o modelo de inteligência artificial Kimi K3 da companhia chinesa, segundo três fontes a par das negociações. Um acordo pode marcar o primeiro grande pacto de compartilhamento de receitas entre uma empresa chinesa de IA e uma grande companhia de computação nuvem dos EUA. Os principais modelos de IA da China são muitas vezes bem mais baratos do que as ofertas ocidentais e estão ganhando força nos EUA, apesar das restrições de Washington que levaram à proibição da exportação de chips de IA para a China. A Moonshot, que se prepara para abrir capital, busca uma participação de até 30% na receita gerada por serviços relacionados ao K3 no Azure da Microsoft, na Amazon Web Services e no Google Cloud, segundo as fontes. As discussões estão em um estágio inicial e não há certeza de que resultarão em acordos, afirmaram as fontes. Moonshot, Microsoft, Google e AWS se recusaram a comentar. A Moonshot tem sido alvo de críticas do secretário do Tesouro dos EUA, Scott Bessent, que afirmou no mês passado que poderia incluí-la em uma lista negra comercial. Autoridades norte-americanas acusam a empresa chinesa de plagiar o modelo mais sofisticado da Anthropic, Fable, para ajudar a criar o Kimi K3, e de adquirir ilegalmente chips de inteligência artificial da Nvidia (NVDA.O) . A Moonshot rejeita as alegações de que o desempenho do Kimi K3 teria sido alcançado por meio de destilação, afirmando ao jornal chinês “National Business Daily” no mês passado que os ganhos de desempenho se devem a alterações originais na arquitetura subjacente. QUESTÕES NÃO RESOLVIDAS De acordo com uma das fontes, as questões não resolvidas nas negociações da Moonshot com as empresas de computação em nuvem dos EUA incluem como a receita poderá ser dividida, o acesso aos dados e a auditoria do uso de tokens. Tokens são unidades de texto processadas por modelos de IA, e medir seu uso é fundamental para calcular a receita no faturamento baseado no uso. O Kimi K3 apresentou resultados sólidos em avaliações independentes. A Arena.ai o classificou em primeiro lugar em um teste que avalia capacidades de construção de interfaces web, enquanto a Artificial Analysis afirma que ele oferece desempenho comparável ao GPT-5.5 da OpenAI e ao Claude Opus 4.8 da Anthropic, especialmente em testes que medem tarefas complexas e com várias etapas. Para grandes fornecedores de modelos de IA, como a Moonshot, os principais provedores de serviços de computação em nuvem são o caminho principal para a adoção de seus produtos por empresas. Embora o Kimi K3 seja um modelo aberto que pode ser baixado e modificado, analistas afirmam que é improvável que muitos clientes executem um sistema com 2,8 trilhões de parâmetros em sua própria infraestrutura devido aos enormes custos de computação envolvidos. A Moonshot assinou acordos semelhantes com algumas plataformas de computação em nuvem menores, segundo as fontes, sem fornecer detalhes. Em julho, a provedora chinesa de serviços de TI Chinasoft International (0354.HK) informou que tinha um acordo de repartição de receitas com a Moonshot, embora não tenha divulgado como isso vai ocorrer. Fundada em 2023 pelo pesquisador de IA Yang Zhilin, formado pela universidade norte-americana Carnegie Mellon, a Moonshot conta com o apoio de vários gigantes da tecnologia chineses, incluindo a gigante da computação em nuvem Alibaba (9988.HK) . A startup levantou mais de US$2 bilhões em maio e está se preparando para uma possível abertura de capital em Hong Kong, segundo fontes. O Alibaba também está buscando acordos de repartição de receita com os principais usuários de seu novo modelo de IA de código aberto, segundo fontes. (Por Liam Mo e Fanny Potkin)

item.title: Orioles' Jackson Holliday vies for another strong game at childhood ballpark in St. Louis
item.description: Jackson Holliday hopes the good results and positive vibes coming from a familiar ballpark can spark him down the stretch for the Baltimore Orioles.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Jackson Holliday hopes the good results and positive vibes coming from a familiar ballpark can spark him down the stretch for the Baltimore Orioles. Holliday spent plenty of time at Busch Stadium watching his dad, slugger Matt Holliday, play for the St. Louis Cardinals (2009-16). But the younger Holliday played there for the first time in the majors on Tuesday night, collecting three hits from the leadoff spot in Baltimore's 13-1 thumping of St. Louis. The two teams will meet again Wednesday night in the second game of a three-game series. "I obviously grew up coming to these games, coming out here for BP and watching my dad play here for a long time," Holliday said. "For me to get out here and play a game in this ballpark, it's pretty cool." Pete Alonso stayed hot in the series opener, hitting a three-run homer and driving in four runs for the Orioles, who are hanging close in the American League wild-card scrum despite a 64-68 record. The Orioles are 2 1/2 games out of the final wild card, one of five teams within three games of the final spot in the AL's postseason field. Alonso has 31 homers this season and a .398 batting average and a .451 on-base percentage in August. Getting more production from Holliday could help the Orioles secure a playoff spot. The No. 1 overall pick in the 2022 MLB Draft, Holliday, 22, has performed below expectations in the majors so far. Earlier this month, Orioles manager Craig Albernaz moved Holliday to the top of the batting order to challenge him. But Holliday is hitting only .188 in August, with a .239 on-base percentage and a .282 slugging percentage. "This baseball game is the worst sometimes," he said. "Even when you hit it good, it's at people. And when you don't, you somehow find a hole." Albernaz said Holliday's improved approach is bound to yield better results despite the rough month. Holliday is batting .236 for the season, with six homers and 27 RBIs. "Jackie's been in a great spot," Albernaz said. "It's been fun to watch him go, and him managing the at-bat has been the biggest thing for me. Getting good pitches to hit and working the count." Injuries have held him back some, and it's easy to forget that Holliday won't turn 23 until December. In his third MLB season, he is the second-youngest player on the roster after Samuel Basallo, who turned 22 on Aug. 13. Holliday said he just needs to keep putting in the work. "I'm just trying to stay steady in my work and process, and it was nice to get some results tonight," Holliday said postgame on Tuesday. The Orioles are scheduled to send right-hander Kyle Bradish (7-12, 3.70 ERA) to the hill on Wednesday. He is 0-3 in four August starts despite allowing eight runs in 22 innings for a 3.48 ERA. Bradish is 1-0 with a 2.25 ERA in two career starts against the Cardinals, both at Busch Stadium. St. Louis fell one game under .500 at 66-67 after dropping the series opener to Baltimore, and the Cardinals remain five games behind the San Diego Padres for the final National League wild-card berth. St. Louis, which has a four-game losing streak, also trails the Arizona Diamondbacks and Miami Marlins in the wild-card standings. Getting blown out on Tuesday felt as dreadful as it looked, Cardinals manager Oliver Marmol said, but it did give him a chance to rest several starting players after the fifth inning. "It wasn't good enough today," Marmol said of the Cardinals' performance. Right-hander Michael McGreevy (5-9, 3.54 ERA) is the scheduled starter on Wednesday and will get the chance to help St. Louis in its push for the postseason. He has yet to face the Orioles. --Field Level Media

item.title: Alibaba's Qwen launches Qwen3.8-Flash AI model with lower training costs
item.description: Alibaba's Qwen has released a new multimodal model, Qwen3.8-Flash, that delivers stronger coding and office-task performance while cutting training costs, it said in a statement on Wednesday published on social media.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Alibaba's (9988.HK) Qwen has released a new multimodal model, Qwen3.8-Flash, that delivers stronger coding and office-task performance while cutting training costs, it said in a statement on Wednesday published on social media. As e-commerce growth stagnates, AI has become the biggest driver of revenue growth for the Chinese e-commerce and cloud computing giant. Its Qwen AI models are some of the most popular in China, where competition is intensifying in the sector. Qwen3.8-Flash supports a default context window of 262,144 tokens, expandable to 1 million tokens, enabling it to handle large files, lengthy conversations and extensive research materials. Compared with its previous Qwen3.7-Plus model, Alibaba said it requires about one-ninth of the training cost. Qwen said it would charge 1 yuan ($0.1488) per million input tokens and 3 yuan per million output tokens for access through its application programming interface. It also released open-source weights for Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, allowing the developer community to evaluate an architecture that Qwen said would serve as a prototype for its next-generation Qwen4 model family. On Sunday, Alibaba launched a heavily discounted HK$80-billion [USN:L6N44L021 TEXT:"share sale"] to fund its AI ambitions. ($1 = 6.7220 Chinese yuan renminbi)

item.title: WHO says Ebola outbreak in Uganda is over, as cases rise in Congo
item.description: The outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Uganda is over but it is not under control in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo, a World Health Organization official told a briefing on Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Jennifer Rigby
item.content:encoded: The outbreak of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in Uganda is over but it is not under control in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo, a World Health Organization official told a briefing on Wednesday. The all-clear for Uganda follows a declaration on July 28 from the Ugandan government that it was [USN:S8N41P031 TEXT:"free of the disease"], which caused 20 cases and two deaths in the country. The WHO monitored the situation until this week to ensure that no chains of transmission had been missed. But Dr Marie Roseline Belizaire, director of emergency preparedness for the WHO African region, told a WHO regional meeting that cases in Democratic Republic of Congo continued to rise despite some progress. The outbreak there is the second-deadliest in history, and outpacing containment efforts. According to the Congolese government, as of Tuesday there have been more than 2,700 deaths and more than 5,600 cases. "Transmission remains very active," said Belizaire. "We have slowed the acceleration, but we have not yet bent this curve." She said there are improvements in contact tracing and testing, and also that analyses of the Bundibugyo virus have not shown any signs of mutation despite the rapid spread. While she described that as good news, she also flagged an immediate $30 million funding gap for logistical operations to deliver medical and personal protective equipment in the worst-hit areas of Congo. "Without this immediate investment, we risk stalling the momentum we have built," she said.

item.title: Indians invest record funds in overseas stocks, debt in June
item.description: Mutual funds investing overseas through the fund-of-funds route also held assets worth 465.5 billion rupees ($4.9 billion) as of July 31 ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Indians sent a record amount of money abroad in June to buy equity and debt, accelerating a trend among local investors to diversify their portfolios overseas. Resident individuals remitted $457 million for the month through the Liberalized Remittance Scheme for buying such assets, according to data published by the Reserve Bank of India late Tuesday.  While the sum is small compared with $3 billion in inflows into domestic equity funds alone during the month, it shows a growing culture of global diversification in India, where investors have traditionally favored gold, term deposits and real estate.  The lackluster performance of local equities has also prompted Indians to look outside. The benchmark NSE Nifty 50 Index is down more than 3 per cent over the past two years, while the S&P 500 Index has gained 37 per cent.  Overseas access has also become easier as the country's tax-free financial hub, GIFT City, helps asset managers launch plans for outbound investments. Funds incorporated out of the business district also avoid the $7 billion industry-wide cap that the market regulator imposed on local funds' overseas investments. Asset managers are making it easy for individual investors to buy stocks and bonds overseas. PPFAS Alternate Asset Managers IFSC Pvt. reduced the minimum investment in its GIFT City-based outbound funds from $5,000 to $500. The change will apply to its two passive funds tracking the S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 indexes. Mutual funds investing overseas through the fund-of-funds route also held assets worth 465.5 billion rupees ($4.9 billion) as of July 31, according to data from the industry body AMFI.

item.title: Irã e Omã continuam trabalhando em acordo sobre Estreito de Ormuz, diz fonte iraniana
item.description: Irã e Omã ainda estão trabalhando nos detalhes de um acordo sobre o Estreito de Ormuz, disse na quarta-feira uma fonte iraniana de alto escalão, depois que a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã informou que os dois países haviam chegado a um acordo sobre como dividir a via navegável e suas receitas.
item.dc:creator: Parisa Hafezi, Jana Choukeir
item.content:encoded: Irã e Omã ainda estão trabalhando nos detalhes de um acordo sobre o Estreito de Ormuz, disse na quarta-feira uma fonte iraniana de alto escalão, depois que a Guarda Revolucionária do Irã informou que os dois países haviam chegado a um acordo sobre como dividir a via navegável e suas receitas. O porta-voz da força de elite, ecoando a posição oficial de Teerã, também disse que o estreito não será aberto a menos que os EUA atendam às condições de Teerã previstas em um acordo de cessar-fogo provisório firmado em junho, antes de ser desfeito. Essas condições incluem o fim do bloqueio dos EUA aos portos iranianos, indenização e a retirada das sanções. Irã e Omã mantêm negociações intermitentes há semanas sobre o controle do tráfego pelo estreito, que era responsável por um quinto dos embarques globais de petróleo e gás natural liquefeito antes do início da guerra, em fevereiro. Desde então, a maior parte do transporte marítimo foi interrompida, elevando os preços globais da energia, enquanto Teerã e Washington tentam afirmar o controle sobre o canal, impondo bloqueios separados. “Um acordo com Omã sobre o Estreito de Ormuz ainda não foi finalizado”, afirmou a fonte iraniana de alto escalão à Reuters, acrescentando que as negociações continuavam sobre os detalhes de um acordo. Um porta-voz da Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica do Irã disse que Irã e Omã tinham chegado a um acordo sobre suas partes no território e nas receitas. “O Estreito de Ormuz pertence ao Irã e ao país de Omã... Estamos em negociações com Omã há cerca de um mês e chegamos a resultados aceitáveis para ambas as partes”, declarou Hossein Mohebbi segundo a mídia estatal iraniana. “Nessas negociações, foram alcançados acordos sobre a participação de cada país nas águas do Estreito e a participação do Irã e Omã em suas receitas”, acrescentou ele. Não ficou imediatamente claro em que fase das negociações os acordos foram alcançados. O Irã havia afirmado no início deste mês que um acordo sobre o estreito estava próximo. Após as conversas na terça-feira entre Irã e Omã, o ministro das Relações Exteriores de Omã, Badr Albusaidi, disse que estava “otimista de que em breve anunciaremos um corredor temporário para o Estreito de Ormuz e medidas práticas para restaurar a navegação segura”. O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, advertiu Omã contra a cooperação com o Irã, afirmando à Fox News em 17 de agosto: “Se Omã atrapalhar, vamos bombardeá-los.” A Guarda Revolucionária Islâmica acusou os Estados Unidos de tentar obstruir as negociações do Irã com Omã e afirmou que isso havia causado um atraso no acordo. “Se os Estados Unidos pararem de obstruir e voltarem ao acordo, poderemos abrir o Estreito de Ormuz dentro da estrutura do acordo alcançado... Se os Estados Unidos não aceitarem nossas condições, o Estreito de Ormuz não será aberto sob nenhuma circunstância”, disse Mohebbi.

item.title: Braves, Dodgers clash in game with potential playoff implications
item.description: Even as Atlanta Braves manager Walt Weiss has watched his team's lead atop the National League East shrink, his confidence in the club hasn't wavered.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: Even as Atlanta Braves manager Walt Weiss has watched his team's lead atop the National League East shrink, his confidence in the club hasn't wavered. The Braves have a chance to continue proving their manager right ahead of the second contest of a three-game series against the visiting Los Angeles Dodgers on Wednesday. After dropping seven of its previous nine games, Atlanta has taken back-to-back games over the league's top two teams in the Milwaukee Brewers and Dodgers. Weiss' group pulled within three games of Los Angeles for the No. 2 seed in the NL with a dramatic 4-3 win in the series opener on Tuesday. "I never doubt that room in there. I never have," Weiss said. "It's a good room. Guys play to win. The mentality of the group is really good and it has to be. There's no season like our season. No other sport plays virtually every day for seven months. You've got to have guys that are made of the right stuff, and we do." AJ Smith-Shawver (0-0, 6.23 ERA) will make his third start of the season for the Braves in just the 19th appearance of his career. The 23-year-old has battled several injuries since being drafted in the seventh round in 2021. Smith-Shawver underwent Tommy John surgery last June before landing on the 60-day injured list to begin this season. Last Wednesday, he yielded four runs on five hits in 4 1/3 innings, walking three and striking out three in a no-decision against the Minnesota Twins. The Braves lost 6-4. Included in a pitching staff ravaged by injury (Atlanta has had 14 pitchers start at least one game this year), the Braves are hoping to rely on Smith-Shawver down the stretch and into the postseason. Starting Wednesday, he'll be looking to string together more consistent outings. "I think that's just been something I've been working on," Smith-Shawver said of trying to work deeper into games. "Just getting deeper in my starts, coming back, getting used to the feels and just how my body is in these innings." Making his first start at Truist Park since May 15, 2025, the right-hander will face the Dodgers for the first time in his career. Los Angeles had its six-game winning streak snapped on Tuesday but remained a game behind Milwaukee for the majors' best record after the Brewers fell to the New York Mets. Roki Sasaki (5-5, 4.42) will start on Wednesday in hopes of extending a two-month personal unbeaten streak. Sasaki last suffered a loss on June 26 and has allowed two runs or fewer in six straight starts. The 24-year-old tossed five innings of two-run, seven-hit ball, striking out six and walking one in a no-decision against the Colorado Rockies on Wednesday. The Dodgers won 6-4 in 10 innings. "He's been great for us," Los Angeles manager Dave Roberts said of Sasaki, who has a 3.18 ERA in three August starts. "Roki is not a finished product, but he's gotten considerably better from last year. Since the All-Star break, you look at the numbers and he's been outstanding." In his lone career outing against the Braves on May 3, 2025, the right-hander allowed three runs on six hits across five innings while striking out four and walking two in a 10-3 victory. --Field Level Media

item.title: Czech farmers cut herds as drought triggers feed crop shortage
item.description: Exceptional summer drought has hit Czech farmers by reducing grain yields but also harming feed crops, leading to scarcity and skyrocketing prices that are forcing some to rush to cut their herds, farm representatives said.
item.dc:creator: Jan Lopatka
item.content:encoded: Exceptional summer drought has hit Czech farmers by reducing grain yields but also harming feed crops, leading to scarcity and skyrocketing prices that are forcing some to rush to cut their herds, farm representatives said. Low milk prices amid a surplus in Europe and high fuel and fertiliser costs caused by the U.S. war on Iran have combined with the rain deficit, cutting into farmers' cash flow. Drought in central Europe has seen [USN:L8N44I0KU TEXT:"yields drop"], emptying dams and drying wells, and emergency power [USN:L1N44C013 TEXT:"plant shutdowns"] due to the lack of cooling water. "In haylage, we are at about half of the harvest we need to secure our feed stock," said Zdenek Duffek, board chairman of Agropodnik Kosetice, a farm with 2,600 hectares of land and about 2,900 cattle 90km southeast of Prague. "This year is very exceptional, because the drought is taking long. There is truly very little precipitation and when it comes, it comes by a millimetre or two, which is not sufficient to provide water for plants." The cost of hay for Czech farmers has risen several times, head of the Czech Agriculture Association Chairman Martin Pycha said, adding that trimming herds was a wider response. "The shortage of hay is great. The price used to be around 500 (per bale), now it is 2,000," Pycha said. Duffek said his farm - which has about 1,000 milk cows and about 600 bulls for meat, as well as calves and heifers - needs about 11,000 tonnes of haylage, which is made by fermenting forage, per year. Even with about 3,000 tonnes of haylage stock from the last year, the farm will still be short about 1,500 tonnes, and the current prices meant sending bulls to the slaughterhouse early and selling young calf was the best option to go. Buying feed is not an economical option, Duffek said. "We have to secure the core herd, the milk cows, we have to give them all we have ... We are reducing rearing bulls, and we are trying to sell out this category so we do not have to feed them." Pycha said the higher supply meant that beef prices were beginning to fall, following other commodities. The sector is facing about 20 billion crown ($968.10 million) drop in revenue for main commodities this year, he said. ($1 = 20.6590 Czech crowns)

item.title: Mark Walter's TWG is working with regulators, says 'no fraud'
item.description: Billionaire Mark Walter's holding company, TWG Global, is working with U.S. regulators to address concerns over related-party investments on the books of his insurance companies, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday, adding there had been "no fraud."
item.dc:creator: Arasu Basil
item.content:encoded: Billionaire Mark Walter's holding company, TWG Global, is working with U.S. regulators to address concerns over related-party investments on the books of his insurance companies, the firm said in a statement on Wednesday, adding there had been "no fraud." Group 1001, a TWG entity that owns Delaware Life Insurance Company and Clear Spring Life and Annuity Company, has filed a plan with the Delaware Department of Insurance to eliminate all of the affiliated exposure at the insurance companies, TWG said in the statement. "This is a straightforward plan to reduce affiliate exposure on the books of the insurance companies in an orderly, measured manner that is beneficial to both the insurance companies and TWG," TWG said, adding the Delaware Department of Insurance was evaluating the plan. Walter's TWG spans financial services, sports, AI and technology. He is best known for his stakes in major professional sports teams, including the Los Angeles Dodgers and the Cadillac Formula 1 team. U.S. prosecutors are investigating insurance companies controlled by Walter over [USN:L4N44F0SP TEXT:"whether certain private credit investments were wrongly categorized"] as unaffiliated investments, according to prior regulatory filings by the insurers. Delaware Life and Clear Spring were subpoenaed by the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Southern District of New York earlier this year, while the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission has also been conducting a parallel investigation, according to the filings. TWG said on Wednesday it was working with the U.S. Department of Justice and the SEC to address their inquiries. The SEC and the DOJ did not immediately respond to Reuters' requests for comment. In June, Delaware Life restated its annual financial statements and reclassified large portions of its private credit investments as related-party assets. The restatement lifted Delaware Life's affiliated investments to 42% of invested assets at the end of 2025 from less than 5%. Insurers are allowed to hold affiliated investments, but they are subject to regulatory requirements and supervisory review as they can present unique risks and potential conflicts of interest, according to the National Association of Insurance Commissioners. TWG earlier this month [USN:L4N44F0SP TEXT:"had agreed to swap up to $6.5 billion"] of Delaware Life's related-party investments for an equivalent amount of assets classified as independent. The transaction, subject to regulatory approval, could reduce Delaware Life's total affiliated assets to roughly 26% of invested assets from 39% as of June 30, according to the insurer. NOT LOOKING TO SELL SPORTS ASSETS AT "FIRE SALE" PRICES TWG said on Wednesday the firm, Walter and his partners continue to get interest from prospective buyers and co-investors in their sports assets, but it wasn't looking to sell them at "fire sale" prices to raise capital for its insurance operations. Walter earlier this month struck a deal to sell the Los Angeles Lakers for [USN:L6N4490WH TEXT:"a record $12.5 billion"] to venture capitalist Joshua Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger. The Los Angeles Dodgers team is not being sold and no sale process has been initiated, TWG said. "Similarly, TWG is not considering exiting its stake in the [USN:L6N44H0XF TEXT:"Cadillac Formula 1 team or any other part of TWG Motorsports"]," TWG said. Walter's business also includes investment bank and advisory firm Guggenheim Partners and a private investment business.

item.title: Meta raggiunge accordo di 16,68 mld dlr per danni social media su minori
item.description: Meta Platforms ha raggiunto un accordo per il pagamento di un importo fino a 16,68 miliardi di dollari e l'introduzione di modifiche sostanziali a Facebook e Instagram per risolvere le accuse mosse da diversi Stati negli Usa.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms (META.O) ha raggiunto un accordo per il pagamento di un importo fino a 16,68 miliardi di dollari e l'introduzione di modifiche sostanziali a Facebook e Instagram per risolvere le accuse mosse da diversi Stati negli Usa. Secondo le parti, l'azienda avrebbe progettato tali piattaforme al fine di creare dipendenza nei bambini, ingannando i consumatori riguardo alla loro sicurezza e raccolgliendo in modo improprio i dati personali dei minori. L'accordo risolve le cause intentate da 29 Stati degli Usa e porrà fine a un processo federale che è stato una delle più importanti verifiche ad oggi delle accuse secondo cui le aziende di social media hanno arrecato danno agli utenti più giovani. Meta imporrà soglie di utilizzo giornaliere e limiterà l'uso notturno da parte dei minori che utilizzano Facebook e Instagram, oltre a potenziare le misure volte a impedire ai minori di accedere a contenuti con limiti di età. L'azienda con sede a Menlo Park, in California, ha negato qualsiasi illecito pur accettando l'accordo.

item.title: PJM capacity market woes spur activity in bilateral power deals
item.description: Power project developers are increasingly seeking bilateral contracts with data centers to finance new projects as recent rises in capacity payments fail to incentivize investment.
item.dc:creator: Anna Flávia Rochas
item.content:encoded: Despite soaring demand from data centers and a large volume of power generation under development, PJM's July capacity auction for 2028/29 fell 6.8 GW short of its target as prices hit maximum levels. This was the second consecutive auction to miss the minimum reserve margin. PJM is the U.S.' largest power network spanning Eastern and Central areas and its capacity pricing model for power generation was designed two decades ago, in a time of more predictable load growth and project development. Investors in dispatchable fossil fuel power plants were willing to accept annual auction revenues as sufficient return and in subsequent years PJM adapted the auction model to accommodate rising renewable energy capacity. CHART: PJM RPM reserve margins, clearing prices Note: IRM = Installed Reserve Margin. RTO = Regional Transmission Organization. RPM = Reliability Pricing Model. Source: PJM Once again, the operator is reviewing its market design and incentives, in response to unprecedented demand from large loads and delays to power generation projects due to supply chain and permitting issues. Soaring demand is outpacing new generation and PJM estimates new large loads will increase by 70 GW by 2038. There is no shortage of proposed new power generation, but developers say capacity payment prices and timelines are insufficient and projects are taking longer to develop amid supply chain, permitting, and workforce challenges. Over 50 GW of power projects have grid connection agreements and are ready to be developed while 220 GW are under evaluation in PJM's grid connection queue. To accelerate new power generation, PJM has introduced a one-time Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) auction and a parallel process to facilitate bilateral power deals between generators and large loads which could support new power capacity. Some projects are already moving forward, buoyed by cap and floor prices implemented by the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) in 2025 in response to spiking PJM auction prices and bilateral contracts. Since then, developers in the region have announced over 43 GW of projects, mostly in data center hubs in Ohio and West Virginia, according to PJM Power Providers Group. Some developers are already "unwinding some of the challenges and seeing where the investment opportunities exist,” said Todd Snitchler, CEO of the Electric Power Supply Association (EPSA). “Capital is flowing even as we're sorting out what's going on with PJM's longer-term market reform effort." Short-term reform PJM's Reliability Backstop Procurement (RBP) auction will offer higher prices and longer contracts than previous auctions. Alongside this, PJM will offer a matchmaking process for new power projects and large loads to secure bilateral deals. Bilateral contracting was highly preferred among members and PJM “supports bilateral activity to bring new load onto the system,” the grid operator said in July. Download our exclusive report on U.S. grid investment trends. The bilateral matchmaking process could support development of new power projects, as capacity market revenue alone is not enough to justify new investments, Ari Pribadi, Global co-head of Investment Banking at Marathon Capital, told Reuters Events. The matchmaking process allows power developers to build on optimum sites away from the data center sites, Pribadi noted. “This is the right policy. Rather than trying to jam a power plant and a data center in a co-located area, this scheme will enable power plants and data centers to be located where each one of them makes sense to be built,” he said. CHART: Forecast power demand growth by US region STEO = EIA's Short-Term Energy Outlook. Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA), February 2026. The bilateral matchmaking process opened in June and will continue for six to nine months with the first matches expected to be disclosed to participants in August. The scheme allows parties to tailor contract structure, including tenure and pricing, to their needs. "Certainly, bilateral contracting for new capacity is the preferred way for everyone for this new capacity to enter the market," Glen Thomas, president of the PJM Power Providers Group association and president of regulatory consulting firm GT Power Group. "If the new large loads can step up [and] sign these bilateral contracts to build the new capacity, it will get developed." Higher price caps PJM's RBP auction has a price cap of $555/MW-day for new generation, far higher than the $325/MW-day price cap in the latest capacity auction in July. Pending approval by FERC, the auction is scheduled to start in late September and close in October with results released by December. Loads that sign bilateral contracts will be excluded from the estimated procurement target in the auction. Projects in the bilateral matching process that do not secure agreements may bid into the auction. PJM's July auction procured 138.3 GW for 2028/29, but only 317 MW came from new generation and 208 MW from upgrades that cleared at the maximum price. Join 1,500+ senior decision-makers across energy and finance at Reuters Events Energy LIVE 2026 . Earthrise Energy CEO Jeff Hunter said the company is “comfortable” with the prices offered in PJM's annual capacity auctions for its existing natural gas-fired plants in the region, but said the caps are not sufficient to attract new dispatchable resources at scale. “All of our assets are contracted, so we're not too concerned about it, but as we look forward, if I were going to do a new development somewhere, thermal [natural gas-fired] or solar or batteries, I would probably look for other markets first,” Hunter told Reuters Events. The higher price cap for the RBP should allow capacity procurement of new natural gas and battery projects, assuming they sign a 15-year contract, according to Julia Hoos, head of USA East (PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, SERC) at Aurora Energy Research. “The hope is that projects that are eligible to participate in the RBP are fairly advanced because they need to construct in the next couple of years and they should have a reasonable handle on what their costs will be,” Hoos noted. However, Curt Morgan, CEO of independent power producer Alphagen, expects only plant upgrades and late-stage development projects that acquired equipment at lower cost to clear in the auction. Most new projects will need higher prices than the cap, he said. AlphaGen plans to participate in the RBP with around 400 MW of upgrades to existing assets, Morgan said. AlphaGen seeks to develop another 2.3 GW of uprates and expansions with natural gas units at its existing PJM sites in Maryland, New Jersey and Ohio. The company is pursuing long-term bilateral arrangements with large loads, mainly data centers, to support capital investment. “Using our expansion projects as an example, which are in [Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative] states in PJM, and assuming contract terms through 2042, we are seeing a need for capacity payments in the $1,285 to $1,665/MW-day for new-build projects,” he said.

item.title: Ações da Nvidia devem sofrer oscilação de US$280 bi após resultados
item.description: Operadores de opções estão precificando uma oscilação de US$280 bilhões no valor de mercado da Nvidia após a empresa divulgar resultados de segundo trimestre na tarde desta quarta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Laura Matthews
item.content:encoded: Operadores de opções estão precificando uma oscilação de US$280 bilhões no valor de mercado da Nvidia (NVDA.O) após a empresa divulgar resultados de segundo trimestre na tarde desta quarta-feira. As opções da fabricante de chips estão precificando uma variação de 5,4% em qualquer direção nesta quinta-feira, um dia após a divulgação dos resultados, o que está abaixo da variação implícita de 6,5% ocorrida antes do relatório de resultados de maio. Essa variação implícita se traduz em cerca de US$280 bilhões em valor de mercado — mais do que o valor de mercado individual de cerca de 90% das empresas que compõem o S&P 500. A variação esperada também permanece bem abaixo da média histórica de oscilação de preço da Nvidia, de 7,4% nos últimos 12 trimestres, de acordo com a empresa de análise Option Research & Technology Services (ORATS). “Isso demonstra certa complacência em relação à Nvidia e significa que ela está se tornando mais previsível”, disse Matt Amberson, fundador da ORATS. Essas variações relativamente modestas refletem um padrão observado nos últimos dois anos, em que as oscilações reais das ações após a divulgação dos resultados frequentemente ficaram aquém do que os mercados de opções haviam precificado, disse Chris Murphy, codiretor de estratégia de derivativos da Susquehanna, uma formadora de mercado. “Acho que o início da era da IA, quando a Nvidia surpreendia a todos com resultados muito acima das expectativas e oscilações de 10, 15, 20 por cento, já ficou para trás”, disse Murphy. “Simplesmente não há mais essa expectativa de que eles vão pegar todo mundo de surpresa com resultados muito acima do esperado e que as ações vão realmente disparar.” As ações da Nvidia registraram na segunda-feira uma queda pelo sétimo dia consecutivo de negociação, mas acumulam valorização de 11,7% neste ano. Enquanto isso, o índice S&P 500 (.SPX) está com alta de 11,8% no ano, e o Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) subiu 61%. PRESSÕES DO MERCADO A retração da Nvidia ocorre em um momento de inquietação generalizada no mercado. Preocupações com o aumento dos preços da energia e o crescente endividamento do governo dos Estados Unidos elevaram os rendimentos dos títulos do Tesouro norte-americano, com os rendimentos de 30 anos atingindo, na semana passada, a maior alta em 19 anos e levando o departamento a anunciar medidas destinadas a aliviar as tensões do mercado. Notícias de que o secretário do Tesouro, Scott Bessent, poderia recorrer à Conta Geral do governo, que soma quase US$1 trilhão, para ajudar a financiar a recompra de títulos em vez de aumentar a emissão de dívida, fizeram com que a taxa de rendimento de 30 anos caísse ligeiramente na segunda-feira, embora ainda permaneça acima de 5%. Nesse contexto, os investidores estarão atentos às projeções de receita da Nvidia, à demanda por chips, à margem de lucro e se os principais provedores de servciços de computação em nuvem continuarão a aumentar os investimento relacionados à inteligência artificial. Como principal fornecedora de chips de IA, a Nvidia é vista como um indicador para o setor de IA como um todo. A Nvidia firmou recentemente parceria com seis grandes instituições financeiras para montar plataformas de financiamento com mais de US$500 bilhões para infraestrutura de IA. A Nvidia provavelmente tem “uma boa noção da trajetória dos investimentos das empresas de tecnologia em IA. O retorno sobre o investimento dessas empresas é realmente importante”, disse Will Sterling, diretor de investimentos da TritonPoint Wealth. “Isso determinará se eles continuarão ou não a investir. Se isso acontecer, acho que será benéfico do ponto de vista da propensão ao risco em todo o ecossistema.”

item.title: Report: Giants WR Calvin Austin III (ACL) out for season
item.description: Giants wideout Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after tearing his right ACL in practice on Tuesday, ESPN reported Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Giants wideout Calvin Austin III will miss the upcoming season after tearing his right ACL in practice on Tuesday, ESPN reported Wednesday. New York signed the 27-year-old veteran to a one-year, $1.5 million contract in the offseason following three seasons with the Steelers, who drafted him in the fourth round in 2022. Austin was carted off the field at training camp Tuesday after his right knee appeared to buckle during a one-on-one drill against Deonte Banks. He was consoled by his teammates on the field and again by Giants co-owner John Mara, who followed Austin in his own cart and tapped the wideout on the helmet and shoulder pads. Austin collected 31 catches for 372 yards and three touchdowns in 14 games (seven starts) last season. He had 84 receptions for 1,100 yards and eight scores in 48 career regular-season games (16 starts) with the Steelers. The Giants' options to replace Austin at slot receiver include Braxton Berrios or veteran Odell Beckham Jr. New York opens the regular season on Sept. 13 at home against Dallas. --Field Level Media

item.title: Insider: Klingbeil und Orcel verabreden Treffen zur Commerzbank
item.description: Die Bundesregierung gibt Insidern zufolge ihre Blockadehaltung gegen die Übernahme der Commerzbank durch die italienische Unicredit auf. Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil wolle nun doch mit Unicredit-Chef Andrea Orcel reden und habe ihn zu einem Treffen am 14. September 2026 nach Berlin eingeladen, erfuhr die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Mittwoch aus Regierungskreisen. Klingbeil wolle die Position der Bundesregierung darlegen und in einen Austausch treten. "Dies begleitet die Gespräche der beiden Banken, denen es weiterhin obliegt, in direkten Beratungen über den weiteren Weg zu sprechen." Der Unicredit-Chef nahm die Einladung einem Vertrauten zufolge an.
item.dc:creator: Christian Krämer
item.content:encoded: Die Bundesregierung gibt Insidern zufolge ihre Blockadehaltung gegen die Übernahme der Commerzbank (CBKG.DE) durch die italienische Unicredit (CRDI.MI) auf. Bundesfinanzminister Lars Klingbeil wolle nun doch mit Unicredit-Chef Andrea Orcel reden und habe ihn zu einem Treffen am 14. September 2026 nach Berlin eingeladen, erfuhr die Nachrichtenagentur Reuters am Mittwoch aus Regierungskreisen. Klingbeil wolle die Position der Bundesregierung darlegen und in einen Austausch treten. "Dies begleitet die Gespräche der beiden Banken, denen es weiterhin obliegt, in direkten Beratungen über den weiteren Weg zu sprechen." Der Unicredit-Chef nahm die Einladung einem Vertrauten zufolge an. Die italienische Bank war nicht unmittelbar für eine Reaktion zu erreichen. Ein Sprecher der Commerzbank und das italienische Wirtschaftsministerium lehnten einen Kommentar ab. Zuletzt hatte die Bundesregierung stets betont, die Banken müssten zunächst miteinander reden. Dies ist mittlerweile geschehen. In Regierungskreisen hieß es, die Rolle der Commerzbank habe für die Finanzierung der deutschen Wirtschaft und des Mittelstands hohe Priorität. "Sie ist als bedeutender Arbeitgeber zudem zentral für den Finanzstandort Frankfurt. Dies gilt es auch in Zukunft sicherzustellen." Die Regierung werde daher weiterhin im Sinne des Mittelstands, des Finanzstandorts Frankfurt und der Beschäftigten handeln. "Dazu stimmt sich die Bundesregierung eng ab. Sie ist zudem in Gesprächen mit der Commerzbank und dem Betriebsrat." Die Mailänder haben mittlerweile [USN:L8N44H156 TEXT:"Zugriff"] auf bis zu 49,65 Prozent der Commerzbank-Anteile. Der Bund, der nach der Rettung in der globalen Finanzkrise aktuell noch gut zwölf Prozent an dem Frankfurter Institut hält, hatte sich lange gegen die Übernahme gestemmt, ebenso wie das Management der Commerzbank. Das Vorgehen von Orcel wurde als feindselig und aggressiv beschrieben. Der Unicredit-Chef hatte seinerseits auf Gespräche mit der Bundesregierung und den Arbeitnehmervertretern gedrängt. BANGEN UM ARBEITSPLÄTZE UND AUSLANDSGESCHÄFT Echte Verhandlungen mit Commerzbank-Chefin Bettina Orlopp gab es bisher nicht. Orcel und Orlopp kamen zwar am Rande einer privaten Veranstaltung zu einem kurzen Austausch zusammen, sprachen aber nur über das weitere Vorgehen nach der Übernahme der Kontrolle durch die Unicredit. Doch auch bei der Commerzbank-Chefin hat sich der Ton geändert. "Ich bin optimistisch, dass wir Schritt für Schritt eine gemeinsame Basis in Bezug auf die Unternehmensführung und auch das Geschäftsmodell finden können", hatte sie bei der Vorlage der Halbjahreszahlen Anfang August gesagt. Orcel sieht bei dem Frankfurter Geldhaus großes Potenzial für Kosteneinsparungen. Die Commerzbank bangt bei einer Übernahme um Arbeitsplätze und um ihr umfangreiches Auslandsnetz, mit dem sie den Mittelstand beim Export begleitet. Orcel will der Commerzbank dagegen das eigene Geschäftsmodell überstülpen, das vor allem auf die europäischen Kernmärkte beschränkt ist. In einigen Jahren könnte eine Fusion mit der Unicredit-Tochter HypoVereinsbank anstehen. Das Münchener Institut, das seit mehr als 20 Jahren zur UniCredit gehört, hatten die Italiener deutlich profitabler gemacht - allerdings auf Kosten seiner Relevanz und Tausender Arbeitsplätze. Die Europäische Zentralbank (EZB), die eine Übernahme genehmigen muss, dürfte trotz einiger Bedenken gegen das Vorgehen der UniCredit wohl Ja zu der Transaktion sagen. In einem Reuters vorliegenden [USN:L8N4490RO TEXT:"vertraulichen Dokument"] kam die EZB zu der vorläufigen Einschätzung, dass es "keinen Grund zur Ablehnung" der Kontrollübernahme der Italiener bei der Commerzbank gebe.

item.title: US imposes sanctions on Palestine Action group
item.description: The United States on Wednesday imposed sanctions on the Palestine Action group, designating it a Specially Designated Global Terrorist, according to a notice posted on a Treasury Department website.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The United States on Wednesday imposed sanctions on the Palestine Action group, designating it a Specially Designated Global Terrorist, according to a notice posted on a Treasury Department website. The United Kingdom previously banned Palestine Action as a terrorist organization. Palestine Action had increasingly targeted Israel‑linked defense companies in Britain with a particular focus on Israel's largest defense firm Elbit Systems (ESLT.TA) . The United Kingdom's Supreme Court has said it will [USN:L1N43L05B TEXT:"hear an appeal"] against a lower court ruling that Britain's decision to ban campaign group Palestine Action as a terrorist organization was lawful.

item.title: Wall Street opera plano antes de resultados de Nvidia; elevada inflación aviva apuestas sobre tasas
item.description: Los principales índices de Wall Street operaban con escasos cambios el miércoles, a la espera de los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia, empresa de referencia en el sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que una inflación superior a lo esperado reforzaba las apuestas por una subida de las tasas de interés en septiembre.
item.dc:creator: Purvi Agarwal
item.content:encoded: Los principales índices de Wall Street operaban con escasos cambios el miércoles, a la espera de los resultados trimestrales de Nvidia, empresa de referencia en el sector de la inteligencia artificial, mientras que una inflación superior a lo esperado reforzaba las apuestas por una subida de las tasas de interés en septiembre. * A las 1353 GMT, el Promedio Industrial Dow Jones (.DJI) cedía 21,54 puntos, o un 0,04%, a 53.555,86 unidades; el índice S&P 500 (.SPX) ganaba 2,24 puntos, o un 0,03%, a 7.679,52 unidades; y el Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) perdía 13,85 puntos, o un 0,06%, a 26.137,16 unidades. * Un informe del Departamento de Comercio reveló que la inflación anual de Estados Unidos aumentó un 3,7% en los 12 meses hasta julio, algo por encima del 3,6% previsto por los analistas, mientras que la economía creció un 1,5% en el segundo trimestre, según una estimación revisada. * Los argumentos a favor de un alza de tasas de la Reserva Federal se reforzaban tras los datos. Los futuros sobre los fondos federales apuntaban a una probabilidad cercana al 44% de que haya un aumento de los tipos en septiembre, frente al 36% previo a la publicación del informe. * "Es evidente que seguimos en un periodo en el que la inflación se mantiene persistente y está ejerciendo temporalmente una presión al alza sobre las tasas, un factor importante para mantener este mercado alcista de la bolsa", afirmó Jeff Buchbinder, estratega jefe de renta variable de LPL Financial. * En el S&P 500, los sectores de tecnología de la información (.SPLRCT) y el industrial (.SPLRCI) eran los que más contribuían al alza, con subidas del 0,3% y del 1%, respectivamente. * Microsoft (MSFT.O) y Apple (AAPL.O) lideraron los avances entre las firmas de megacapitalización, con una mejora del 0,5% cada una. * El gigante de los chips de IA, Nvidia (NVDA.O) , restaba un 0,4% a la espera de su informe trimestral, que se sigue con gran atención. Cualquier resultado que no sea espectacular podría reavivar las dudas sobre la sostenibilidad del auge de la IA y marcar la pauta para las acciones tecnológicas durante el resto de la semana.

item.title: Sodexo plans to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France
item.description: French food caterer Sodexo said on Wednesday it planned to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France as part of an overhaul meant to accelerate growth and improve competitiveness.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French food caterer Sodexo (EXHO.PA) said on Wednesday it planned to cut more than 1,000 jobs in France as part of an overhaul meant to accelerate growth and improve competitiveness. The company said it would eliminate 963 positions, equal to 4% of its French workforce, while a separate project tied to the group head office could result in a further 134 job losses.

item.title: US says Chinese hackers broke into Justice Department, NASA, Federal Reserve, Senate and more
item.description: The United States said Wednesday that it had disrupted a Chinese hacking operation responsible for break-ins at the U.S. Justice Department, NASA, the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Senate, and other sensitive government agencies.
item.dc:creator: Raphael Satter, A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: The United States said Wednesday that it had disrupted a Chinese hacking operation responsible for break-ins at the U.S. Justice Department, NASA, the Federal Reserve, the U.S. Senate, and other sensitive government agencies. In a statement , the Justice Department said that it had seized domains used by two hacking platforms, dubbed “QScan” and “QTRouter,” which it said had been used as part of the campaign. An affidavit identified the U.S. Department of Energy, the Department of Health and Human Services, the National Institutes of Health, and four unnamed companies in the United States and South Korea as being among the hackers' victims. The Chinese Embassy in Washington did not immediately return a message seeking comment. Beijing routinely denies responsibility for hacking activity. The Justice Department said that the platforms were run by a China-based firm, the Nanjing Xinjiuwei Network Technology Company, whose clients it said included China's civilian intelligence agency, the Ministry of State Security and its military, the People’s Liberation Army. Reuters could not immediately locate contact details for Nanjing Xinjiuwei. The affidavit said the group's computer infrastructure had been used to compromise critical infrastructure and other sensitive networks in the U.S. and worldwide since at least 2018. Experts who follow Chinese cyber activity say that private contractors routinely carry out high-profile intrusions on behalf of various Chinese government agencies. "Over the last decade, the number of companies offering niche offensive services has exploded," said Dakota Cary, a China analyst with cybersecurity company SentinelOne.

item.title: Report: Bucs rookie LB Rueben Bain Jr. has AC sprain
item.description: Buccaneers rookie linebacker Rueben Bain Jr. is dealing with a shoulder injury but is expected to play in Week 1, ESPN reported Wednesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Buccaneers rookie linebacker Rueben Bain Jr. is dealing with a shoulder injury but is expected to play in Week 1, ESPN reported Wednesday. The first-round draft pick (15th overall) out of Miami sustained an AC sprain during Tampa Bay's joint practice with the Jaguars on Tuesday, per the report. The Bucs finish their preseason slate at Jacksonville on Friday and open the regular season at Cincinnati on Sept. 13. Bain was named the ACC Defensive Player of the Year in 2025 after racking up 9.5 sacks and helping the Hurricanes reach the national championship game. Bain, 21, is projected to start at linebacker alongside Alex Anzalone and Christian Rozeboom. He notched 20.5 sacks, 33.5 tackles for loss, 121 tackles, four forced fumbles and one interception in 38 games at Miami. --Field Level Media

item.title: Katastrophe im Himalaja - Dutzende Tote nach gewaltigem Erdrutsch
item.description: Ein gewaltiger Erdrutsch aus Schlamm und Geröll hat am Mittwoch an der Grenze zwischen Nepal und der chinesischen Region Tibet eine verheerende Flutkatastrophe ausgelöst. Nach Angaben der Behörden kamen auf der nepalesischen Seite mindestens 95 Menschen ums Leben, zudem werden Hunderte Touristen vermisst. Videos zeigten, wie Dutzende Menschen an der Grenze von den Wassermassen fortgerissen wurden. Häuser, Straßen und Wasserkraftwerke wurden in Nepal weggeschwemmt. Auch auf der chinesischen Seite im Bezirk Gyirong befürchten die Behörden nach einem Geröllabgang an einem Grenzübergang zahlreiche Opfer.
item.dc:creator: Gopal Sharma, Liz Lee, Navesh Chitrakar
item.content:encoded: Ein gewaltiger Erdrutsch aus Schlamm und Geröll hat am Mittwoch an der Grenze zwischen Nepal und der chinesischen Region Tibet eine verheerende Flutkatastrophe ausgelöst. Nach Angaben der Behörden kamen auf der nepalesischen Seite mindestens 95 Menschen ums Leben, zudem werden Hunderte Touristen vermisst. Videos zeigten, wie Dutzende Menschen an der Grenze von den Wassermassen fortgerissen wurden. Häuser, Straßen und Wasserkraftwerke wurden in Nepal weggeschwemmt. Auch auf der chinesischen Seite im Bezirk Gyirong befürchten die Behörden nach einem Geröllabgang an einem Grenzübergang zahlreiche Opfer. "Das gesamte Ausmaß der Sturzflut ist aktuell schwer abzuschätzen und die Lage in Nepal weiterhin unübersichtlich", hieß es aus dem Auswärtigen Amt in Berlin. "Es ist leider mit sehr vielen Todesopfern zu rechnen." Zum jetzigen Zeitpunkt lägen aber keine Erkenntnisse über deutsche Staatsangehörige unter den Betroffenen vor. Die Botschaft in Kathmandu sei mit den lokalen Behörden in engem Kontakt. Laut Deutschem Reiseverband ist derzeit in Nepal beispielsweise für Trekking-Touren keine Hauptsaison. Nach Angaben des nepalesischen Tourismusministeriums werden seit dem Erdrutsch 341 Ausländer vermisst. Da die Schlamm- und Wassermassen aus einer Höhe von fast 2000 Metern herabstürzten, wurde im angrenzenden Norden Indiens Hochwasseralarm ausgelöst. In den Bundesstaaten Uttar Pradesh und Bihar strömen mehrere Flüsse aus den Bergen in die Ebene. Die Behörden in Bihar evakuierten nach eigenen Angaben etwa 5000 Menschen aus sechs Bezirken. Insgesamt sollen 10.000 bis 12.000 Menschen in Sicherheit gebracht werden. "VOLLSTÄNDIG WEGGESCHWEMMT" Unter den Vermissten in der Region befinden sich der nepalesischen Tourismusbehörde zufolge 105 Inder, 93 Nepalesen, drei US-Bürger und zwölf Briten. Zudem teilte Südkorea mit, dass acht seiner Staatsbürger vermisst würden, die an einem Wasserkraftwerk arbeiteten. Rettungskräfte bargen bislang 55 Leichen. Weitere 65 Verletzte werden in Krankenhäusern der Region sowie in der Hauptstadt Kathmandu behandelt. "Überall, wo wir hinschauen, herrscht Verwüstung", sagte der nepalesische Sanitäter Tula Bahadur BK der Nachrichtenagentur Reuters. "Die Siedlungen direkt am Fluss wurden vollständig weggeschwemmt. Fünf meiner Verwandten werden vermisst." Als Ursache für das Unglück wird ein Erdbeben vermutet. Nepals Außenminister Shisir Khanal erklärte am Mittwoch vor dem Parlament, erste Berichte deuteten darauf hin, dass ein Beben eine Lawine ausgelöst haben könnte. Das Deutsche GeoForschungsZentrum (GFZ) registrierte etwa sieben Minuten vor dem auf Überwachungskameras festgehaltenen Erdrutsch einen Erdstoß der Stärke 4,4. Satellitenbilder deuten darauf hin, dass eine Lawine aus Schnee und Fels eine Mure im Fluss Lhende ausgelöst habe, teilte die nepalesische Katastrophenschutzbehörde mit. Die Rettungsarbeiten gestalteten sich schwierig. In den nepalesischen Bergorten Syapru Besi und Timure im Distrikt Rasuwa mit rund 50.000 Einwohnern konnten Rettungshubschrauber wegen des Hochwassers zunächst nicht landen. Auf der chinesischen Seite war der Grenzübergang Gyirong schwer betroffen. Die staatliche Nachrichtenagentur Xinhua meldete, der Erdrutsch habe Straßen blockiert sowie Kommunikations- und Stromleitungen in der Region Shigatse unterbrochen. "DER SCHLAMM IST SEHR ZÄH" Chinas Präsident Xi Jinping forderte einen umfassenden Rettungseinsatz. Die Behörden entsandten 601 Einsatzkräfte, 113 Fahrzeuge sowie Suchhunde. Ein Retter berichtete im staatlichen Fernsehen CCTV, Drohnenaufnahmen zeigten, dass alle Straßen zum Grenzübergang "vollständig zerstört" sind. "Die Lage nach dem Erdrutsch ist in der Tat sehr ernst", sagte er. "Der Schlamm ist sehr zäh, und das Wetter bereitet uns große Sorgen – es regnet ununterbrochen, so dass der Wasserstand jederzeit steigen kann." Der betroffene Fluss Bhote Koshi entspringt in Tibet, fließt durch Nepal und tritt schließlich in Indien als Gandak in die Ebene aus. Im vergangenen Jahr waren durch eine Flut am Bhote Koshi, die durch den Bruch eines Gletschersees in Tibet verursacht worden war, neun Menschen ums Leben gekommen, 24 weitere Personen gelten seither als vermisst.

item.title: Royals pursue 10th straight victory in rematch with Blue Jays
item.description: The Toronto Blue Jays are supposed to be in an easier part of their schedule against below .500 teams, but it has not started that way.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Toronto Blue Jays are supposed to be in an easier part of their schedule against below .500 teams, but it has not started that way. Sometimes it is not who you play, but when you play them. The Blue Jays opened their stretch against teams with losing records Tuesday night with a 5-3 defeat to the Kansas City Royals, who have won nine games in a row for the first time since 2017. The middle contest of the three-game series between the Royals and Blue Jays will be Wednesday night in Toronto. "They've strung together a nice stretch of games here, and I'm glad they are getting rewarded for it," Royals manager Matt Quatraro said. Kansas City had 10 hits and walked nine times on Tuesday. "It's incredible," said catcher Carter Jensen, who had a single, a walk and a sacrifice fly. "One through nine, everybody is putting up amazing at-bats. No one is taking any pitches off, and no one is giving away any at-bats." The Royals, however, did strand 14 runners. By losing the opener of a six-game homestand, the Blue Jays have dropped three of their past four games and cannot continue that trend if they want to stay in the American League wild-card race. The Blue Jays did not help themselves on Tuesday: First baseman Vladimir Guerrero Jr.'s throwing error on a bunt helped the Royals to a two-run sixth. When Toronto rallied in the ninth, Nathan Lukes was out at second to end the game as he tried to stretch his two-run single to left-center field. Guerrero would have been the next batter. "I think there you just want to be careful and get the tying run up there, with the middle of the order coming," Blue Jays manager John Schneider said. "If it's going to be that close. I think just put the brakes on." Said Quatraro: "I don't know if I've seen a game end that way on a relay and ball in the gap like that. But I'm glad it did end that way." The Royals will start right-hander Randy Dobnak (2-1, 1.58 ERA) on Wednesday. He has never faced Toronto in his career. Right-hander Spencer Miles (5-2, 3.02 ERA) is expected to be the opener for the Blue Jays in what will be a bullpen game. He has never faced the Royals. Toronto put starting right-handed pitcher Shane Bieber on the 15-day injured list Tuesday because of inflammation of the teres major muscle in his throwing shoulder. "He felt a little bit of discomfort in his bullpen Sunday in New York (vs. the Yankees), so he had an MRI that night when we got back," Schneider said. "It's a moderate to mild teres major injury, which sucks for him and sucks for us. He'll be down from throwing for a couple of weeks and we'll go from there. ... This is tough timing, for sure, with where we are and how Shane was throwing, too. We've dealt with it before this year, and we'll continue to do it." Right-hander Chad Dallas was recalled by Toronto from Triple-A Buffalo. Meanwhile, Royals second baseman Michael Massey left Tuesday's game in the fifth after making a superb play to throw out Lukes at first. Massey lost his balance and fell backward on the play, hitting his head. "That's why we took him out," Quatraro said of the circumstances. "He's doing well now. We're just going to have to monitor him overnight and see that he is all right. ... It was just a little bit of neck soreness right away. But it's resolved." Massey was 0-for-2 with a walk. He was replaced by Tyler Tolbert, who was 1-for-2 with a stolen base. --Field Level Media

item.title: Mercado argentino ajusta liquidez, Gobierno busca impulsar la economía
item.description: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba el miércoles a niveles ajustados de liquidez, previo a la última licitación mensual de deuda del Tesoro y de cara al cierre de carteras de agosto.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El mercado financiero de Argentina se reacomodaba el miércoles a niveles ajustados de liquidez, previo a la última licitación mensual de deuda del Tesoro y de cara al cierre de carteras de agosto. La moneda nacional, el peso, renovaba su piso histórico intradiario, mientras que los activos tendían a mejorar ante un controlado riesgo país, aunque aún por arriba de los 500 puntos básicos. Ante una economía doméstica que no alcanza a despegar con fortaleza, el Gobierno anunció un esquema para promover los créditos hipotecarios para fomentar una mayor dinámica. El ministro de Economía, Luis Caputo, dijo en ronda de prensa que el oficial 'Fondo de Garantía Sustentable' (FGS) del ente previsional ANSES licitará depósitos a plazo fijo atados a la inflación (UVA) y contra eso los bancos deberán asignar fondos a otorgar préstamos para la vivienda con tasas mínimas para los depósitos y máximas para los créditos. El peso mayorista perdía un 0,2% a récord mínimo de 1.515 por dólar a las 1425 GMT, junto a contratos a futuro con una ligera tendencia de baja. Esta coyuntura hace que el banco central (BCRA) disminuya la sumatoria diaria de dólares adquiridos para respaldar sus reservas internacionales, las que suman casi 51.000 millones de dólares. "La cantidad de dinero continúa siendo la variable de ajuste de la política monetaria, generando volatilidad en las tasas; pese a que la aparición de liquidez sobre el cierre (de la semana pasada) redujo el costo de 'funding' impulsando la renta fija, persiste la cautela del mercado ante eventuales nuevos ajustes monetarios", reportó el banco Patagonia. "En este esquema, el banco central (BCRA) priorizaría la estabilidad cambiaria por sobre la de tasas, dado su rol en el anclaje de expectativas; la inflación mayorista de 0,8% (en julio) constituye una señal positiva", agregó. El índice accionario S&P Merval (.MERV) de la bolsa de Buenos Aires subía un 0,6% y los bonos públicos extrabursátiles permanecían equilibrados en promedio, con un riesgo país en la zona de los 509 unidades. El Tesoro buscará este jueves renovar deuda interna para afrontar obligaciones por unos 12,6 billones de pesos (unos 8.330 millones de dólares), sin que aparezca en carpeta el Bonar 29 ('AO29'). Para esta operatoria se ofrecerán tres papeles a tasa fija ('S30N6', 'S29E7' y 'T31Y7'), una letra Lecer ('X29E7') y otra atada al 'dollar linked' ('D30O6'), todos con amortización durante el mandato libertario de Javier Milei, quien preside Argentina hasta finales del 2027. Gran parte del compromiso a cubrir está dado por títulos atados al tipo de cambio, cuya paridad para el pago será el del peso al cierre de este miércoles en la franja interbancaria. "El Tesoro vuelve a ofrecer un menú de instrumentos de corto plazo, con mayor presencia de alternativas a tasa fija aprovechando la caída en los 'break evens' de inflación. El objetivo es no presionar a la curva pesos, ni esterilizando ni sumando oferta de bonos largos", sostuvo el agente de liquidación y compensación Facimex. Acotó que "el atractivo está en la (letra) Lecer de enero (X29E7) aprovechando que el tramo corto 'CER' (inflación) quedó con rendimientos elevados. La ausencia del Bonar 'AO29' no sorprende bajo las condiciones de mercado actuales".

The Commerce Department said the Personal

NEW YORK, Aug 26 : The dollar was higher on Wednesday after a round of U.S. economic data, including a reading on inflation that slightly increased expectations for a rate hike from the Federal Reserve ahead of the Jackson Hole symposium of central bankers this week. The Commerce Department said the Personal Consumption Expenditures Price Index increased 3.7 per cent in the 12 months through July, unchanged from June and slightly above the 3.6 per cent estimate of economists polled by Reuters. On a month-over-month basis, PCE rose 0.2 per cent versus the estimate calling for a 0.1 per cent increase, after falling 0.1 per cent in June. "Overall, because the headline was warm enough to prevent a dovish victory, those details weren't really strong enough to hand the hawks a clear win, so I wouldn't chase the rally at all," said George Vessey, lead FX and macro strategist at Convera in London. "But I wouldn't fade it aggressively either, we've got loads of competing narratives driving FX at the moment, particularly the dollar, haven't we, so it's hard to have a strong conviction in either direction right now."

The dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of currencies, rose 0.21 per cent to 99.12 and was on pace for its biggest daily gain since August 6, with the euro down 0.16 per cent at $1.1655. ECB SIGNALS FURTHER RATE RISES European Central Bank (ECB) board member Isabel Schnabel said interest rates must rise further as the conflict in the Middle East drags on and the strong euro zone economy poses upside risks to inflation, in an interview with Bloomberg News published on Wednesday. The comments came after Reuters reported on Tuesday that ECB policymakers are ready to raise interest rates at their next meeting in September to contain the side-effects of the Iran war but they have little appetite to signal further tightening after that. Separately, other U.S. data showed the updated reading of second-quarter economic growth came in at 1.5 per cent, unchanged from the initial estimate. The Commerce Department also said personal income increased 0.4 per cent in July, topping the 0.2 per cent estimate, while consumer spending, which accounts for more than two-thirds of economic activity, was unchanged after a 0.3 per cent increase in June. Expectations for a rate hike from the Fed inched up after the data, with markets now pricing in a 40.1 per cent chance for an increase of at least 25 basis points at the central bank's September meeting, according to CME FedWatch, up from about 36 per cent before the release. On Friday, Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh will make his debut speech at the annual Jackson Hole conference, although many market participants believe it is unlikely the central bank head will offer any policy outlook. Boston Fed President Susan Collins said on Tuesday that the Fed will need to raise interest rates soon unless coming data show a continued decline in inflation that remains too high and which has become a "pervasive" concern for businesses and households. The greenback had stumbled late last week after U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the Treasury would double the size of quarterly repurchases of longer-dated bonds, sparking concerns that a shift to a more direct strategy to mitigate the rise in borrowing costs could lead to a debasement of the dollar. The Canadian dollar weakened 0.24 per cent versus the greenback to C$1.387 per dollar, reversing slight gains from the prior day after Ottawa placed retaliatory tariffs on about $20 billion worth of U.S. annual imports and rolled out aid for businesses and workers after trade talks with the U.S. collapsed over the weekend. The Japanese yen weakened 0.11 per cent against the greenback to 159.34 per dollar. Sterling weakened 0.35 per cent to $1.3601 and was on track for its biggest daily drop since August 3.

Source: Reuters

item.title: Meta to pay up to $16.7 billion to settle social media addiction cases
item.description: The deal requires Meta to put new guardrails on its platforms, including restricting how much time youths can scroll and preventing them from switching off certain safety settings ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: Meta Platforms Inc. has agreed to pay up to $16.7 billion to settle a landmark social media case with multiple US states, according to a court filing Wednesday. The deal requires the company to put new guardrails on its platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, including restricting how much time youths can scroll and preventing them from switching off certain safety settings without parental consent. A judge needs to sign off on the agreement.  Meta didn't immediately respond to a request for comment.  The accord comes in the second week of a jury trial in federal court in Oakland, California, that posed enormous risk for Meta. The top legal officers of 29 states were seeking not only massive financial penalties on behalf of the public, but also court orders that could force the company to change how it operates its platforms.  Bloomberg reported late Tuesday that the parties had discussed a possible mid-trial settlement.

FAST

LONDON, Aug 26 : Appeal court judges will take two to three weeks to decide the final results of June's Monaco Grand Prix after a hearing on Tuesday, Formula One's governing body said. The FIA's international court of appeal met behind closed doors in Paris in a case that will determine whether third place stays with Alpine's Pierre Gasly or goes to Red Bull's Isack Hadjar, with knock-on effects for others immediately behind. Gasly finished third on track on June 7 but was demoted to seventh when two five-second penalties for pit-lane speeding were applied post-race, with fellow Frenchman Hadjar promoted to third and spraying the champagne. That decision was overturned after a right to review on June 12, stewards accepting Renault-owned Alpine's evidence that there had been a timekeeping error. Hadjar then handed the trophy back to Gasly before his team and McLaren appealed on June 16.

As well as Hadjar dropping down, in a race won by Mercedes' championship leader Kimi Antonelli with Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton second, McLaren's Oscar Piastri moved down to fifth, with Liam Lawson sixth and Arvid Lindblad seventh for Red Bull-owned Racing Bulls. McLaren team boss Andrea Stella said at the weekend's Dutch Grand Prix that the removal of Gasly's penalties raised significant elements of concern from a position of fairness. PIASTRI PENALTIES Piastri also got penalties for the same speeding offence but he, unlike Gasly, served them during the race - a situation that could not be overturned and cost the Australian places and points. Mercedes driver George Russell, a title contender, finished out of the points after serving a drive-through penalty for pit-lane speeding. He said that he had pleaded for his penalty to be added post-race to retain a chance of it being overturned. "There's a general interest for Formula One and the sport and the integrity of the sport, and there's a material interest for McLaren in terms of our championship impact," said Stella of McLaren's reasons for appealing. Stewards noted when Gasly's penalties were overturned that the situation was unfair to others. "There is no regulation that gives the stewards the power to 'undo' a served penalty. In any case, it is impossible to imagine how such power could be applied," they said at the time. No details emerged from Tuesday's confidential hearing. Formula One's next race is the Italian Grand Prix in Monza on September 6, followed by the debut of Madrid's new circuit on September 13.

item.title: トランプ氏、対カナダ強硬姿勢維持 「もう許されない」
item.description:
Bo Erickson
[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Bo Erickson

[ワシントン ２６日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２６日、貿易問題を巡り対立が深まるカナダについて、「このようなことはもはや許されないと教える時だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は保守系政治評論家グレン・ベック氏とのインタビューで、カナダと「かなり良いディールが成立していた」と説明。その上で「われわれはカナダから、どうしても必要としているものはない。多少の不便はあるかもしれないが、他の場所から調達できる」とし、「今こそカナダに対し『もうこのようなことは許されない』と教える時が来た」と語った。

米国は２２日、カナダとの通商交渉が決裂したことを受け、約２００億ドル相当のカナダ製品に対する５０％の追加関税を発動。カナダも２５日、９月８日から米措置と同規模となる２７６億カナダドル（約１９９億４０００万米ドル）相当の米国製品に報復関税を課すと発表。鉄鋼やアルミニウムなどの主要分野に５０％の関税を適用する。

ホワイトハウスのナバロ大統領上級顧問（貿易・製造業担当）はＣ－ＳＰＡＮに対し、カナダが最終的に米国と締結する合意は先週提示された内容よりも「劣るだろう」とし、「カナダにとって良い結果にはならない」との認識を示した。

米国がカナダに提示していた案は、カナダに非常に有利な内容だったとし、「経済的に考えれば、カナダが拒否する理由はなかったはずだ」と語った。

item.title: 米国債下落、コアPCE価格発表後も利上げ観測変わらず－株もみ合い
item.description: （ブルームバーグ）：
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded:
（ブルームバーグ）： 26日午前の米株式相場は方向感に乏しい展開。最新の米経済指標を受けても米連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が年内に利上げを実施するとの観測に変化はなく、国債売りが優勢になっている。

7月の米個人消費支出（PCE）は実質ベースで前月比横ばいとなり、注目度の高いPCE価格指数はコアが予想通りとなった。4－6月期（第2四半期）の米実質国内総生産（GDP）改定値は前期比年率1.5%増と、速報値から変わらずで、市場予想に一致した。

短期金融市場は12月までの利上げを完全に織り込んでいる。国債市場では相対的に短期債の下げがきつい。

S&P500種株価指数はもみ合い。市場はエヌビディアの決算発表待ちとなっている。

イランとオマーンがホルムズ海峡の再開に向けて協議する中、原油は下落した。

外国為替市場では、ドルが主要通貨に対して上昇。円は対ドルで下げに転じ、1ドル＝159円台前半で推移している。

LONDON, Aug 26 : England will look to secure their first test series victory in almost two years and shift the focus back to cricket when they face Pakistan in the second test at Lord's starting on Thursday. The first-test victory by an innings and 103 runs marked the start of Joe Root's second stint as test captain but he was seething when addressing the media on Tuesday following another embarrassing disciplinary breach. Root said he was "hacked off" after videos on social media appeared to show England fast bowler Brydon Carse in handcuffs being spoken to by police officers on Saturday outside a nightclub in Derby. He was subsequently dropped from the squad for the second test.

Fast bowler Josh Tongue said Root's firm talk had resonated with the players. "It was a chat that was needed, a very good chat from Rooty," the 28-year-old Tongue told reporters on Wednesday. "He's been around the England dressing room for plenty of years now, he knows what it takes to be the top professional and I think we've just got to do the best we can moving forward. "I think we've just got to make sure we're as professional as we can be. Obviously things have happened and we need to try and move on from them to show all the youngsters growing up wanting to play for England that it's an amazing place to be," Tongue added. OFF-FIELD ILL-DISCIPLINE England have won three and lost six of their nine tests since last October - a period marked by ill-discipline off the pitch including white-ball captain Harry Brook fined £30,000 ($41,000) for an altercation with a bouncer in Wellington, and reports of a booze-fuelled mid-series break during the Ashes in Noosa. Former test captain Ben Stokes and Gus Atkinson broke a curfew after the first test win over New Zealand this year and were dropped for the next match. Victory at Lord's would help turn the focus back on cricket and England will be strong favourites as they are likely to field an unchanged team from Headingley. Tongue and Ollie Robinson took eight wickets apiece in the first test as Pakistan's batting crumbled but Root is expecting a sterner test with the touring side hopeful that captain Babar Azam will return from a finger injury. "We know the individual brilliance that lies within that team and what Pakistan are capable of collectively," he said. "We also know that whenever we play anyone at Lord's, they generally raise their game. This (England) group won't be taking anything for granted." ($1 = £0.7352)

Source: Reuters
